AD-400 — Starting selection brief
Manufacturer: Boya Gongdao

A specialist platform for long-distance inspection of flooded water tunnels, combining a tethered vehicle with project-specific sensing and tether management.

Vehicle weight: 300 kg
Depth rating: 1,000 m
Official-site maximum range: 5 km
Dimensions: 1,600 × 900 × 548 mm
Forward camera: 4K
Rear camera: 1080p
Power: External tethered supply

Configuration note: The official website states a maximum operation distance of 5 km; the supplied brochure lists 5.5 km. The deliverable range must be confirmed against the supplied version and project conditions.

Confirm current specifications and delivered scope with the manufacturer before purchase.
